scholarships.title: Becas El Quantificador 2026-2027 (LIDE + DataCamp)
scholarships.official_source: Laboratorio de Investigacion para el Desarrollo del Ecuador (LIDE)

eligibility: Availability of time and motivation to study independently
No restriction on field of study or employment situation
Like the official call publication on any of El Quantificador's social networks and follow the account on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky or Threads
Former LIDE-DataCamp scholarship holders may apply again
existing.eligibility_summary: Anyone with economic need, regardless of degree subject or employment situation, who has the time and motivation to study independently. Applicants must like the official call post on El Quantificador's social media and follow the account. No nationality or residence restriction.
benefits: One free DataCamp licence valid 1 November 2026 to 1 November 2027
Access to DataCamp programming and data-science courses
Invitation to a four-session training course
coverage: One free DataCamp licence valid 1 November 2026 to 1 November 2027
Access to DataCamp programming and data-science courses
Invitation to a four-session training course
requirements: Like the official call post and follow El Quantificador on at least one of the listed social networks

Accept monthly monitoring: LIDE sends a reminder between the 25th and the last day of each month and reviews DataCamp activity between the 3rd and 5th of the following month, including XP and activity dates
application_method: Online Google Form published in the official call
existing.selection_notes: Applications are reviewed and selected between 21 and 27 October 2026 and selected people are contacted by email before 28 October 2026. The call does not publish selection criteria or weighting. Licence validity is subject to renewal and activation by DataCamp, and LIDE states it will inform fellows promptly of any operational delays.
existing.best_fit: Students and workers in Ecuador, or anywhere, who cannot afford paid data-science training, want to learn Excel, Power BI, Tableau, R, Python or SQL, and can commit to studying independently with monthly activity monitoring.
existing.notes:
LIDE describes itself as an independent, non-partisan research centre that promotes evidence-based social policy, and is legally registered at 900 Washington Ave SE Unit 402, Minneapolis, Minnesota, while this programme is stated to be located throughout Ecuador and funded by DataCamp. This is a non-stipend training bursary: it covers a commercial platform licence and training, not tuition, living costs or travel.
Funding period: The programme page states an annual budget of USD 6,000 for the whole Becas El Quantificador programme, not a per-beneficiary amount
existing.duration: 12 months of DataCamp licence access, from 1 November 2026 to 1 November 2027
existing.application_period: Opened 18 September 2026, closes 20 October 2026; selection review 21-27 October 2026; winners contacted by email before 28 October 2026; course sessions 28-29 October and 4-5 November 2026
existing.program_type: NGO and corporate sponsored data-skills bursary with free platform access
